exchanges: morning just finished a 15k with the club and my legs are jelly
Nice work on the 15k. Jelly legs mean you earned breakfast.
ravi had us doing hill repeats at the end which felt illegal
Hill repeats at the end of a long run is a tough coach move. Good for strength though.
he used to run for kenya at junior level so his idea of easy is not normal
That explains a lot about the hill repeats.
lol yeah anyway me and mei are going to marrakech in january for the marathon
That's a great race, flat and usually cool in January. Is it Mei's first marathon?
her third shes faster than me she did berlin last year in like 3 hours 20
That's a strong time. Are you two running it together or separately?
separately shed leave me in the dust
Fair enough, run your own race.
my brother tariq might come too hes been learning korean for like two years and wants to practice on anyone lol not sure morocco helps with that
Not a lot of chances for that in Marrakech, but he might enjoy the trip anyway.
true hes obsessed tho he watches dramas with no subtitles now
That's real progress after two years.
my sisters husband owen is also on a language kick hes doing portuguese because his company has an office in sao paulo
Sounds like the family has a language streak right now.
competitive family lol
Clearly.
ok so aiyana from the club said she might come too she works at the aquarium downtown and has a bunch of vacation saved up
That would make it a proper group trip.
shes the one who got me into running in the first place
Then it would be nice to have her there for the race.
do you know if its hot in marrakech in january
Not really, days are usually mild, around 18 to 20 degrees, and nights can be quite cold.
cold nights noted. where should we stay medina or new town
The medina has more atmosphere and riads, while Gueliz in the new town is quieter and more modern.
riad sounds fun mei wants a rooftop
Lots of riads have rooftop terraces, so that's an easy wish to meet.
oh wait aiyana doesnt work at the aquarium its the planetarium i always say the wrong one
Easy slip, they sound alike. Stars instead of fish, then.
ya she does the night sky shows for school groups
That sounds like a fun job.
anyway my grandpa thinks im insane for running 42k for fun
A lot of grandparents feel that way. Does he do anything active?
he plays lawn bowls three times a week and takes it more seriously than i take running
That's a great match for his attitude, then.
lol hes the club champion two years running
Impressive. Maybe competitiveness is the family trait.
probably ok training question how long should my longest run be before the marathon
Most plans peak around 32 to 35 kilometres, about three weeks before race day.
ok ravi said 32 too
Then you're getting consistent advice.
i need new shoes tho mine are falling apart, mei swears by her asics so i might get those
Those are popular for marathon training. Get them soon so you have time to break them in before January.
